text:
incident-bot: Paging @eng-oncall — elevated 5xx rate observed on /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Current error rate 6.2% over 5m, threshold 1%. Correlated with upstream control-plane auth and org-lookup failures. Incident severity: sev2. Link to alert: https://monitoring/redwood/alerts/1234 :rotating_light:

sam (eng-oncall): i'm on it, looking at traces now. can anyone confirm if this is auth token failure or org service timeouts?

neha (sre): seeing a spike of 502/504 from control-plane:auth (10.1.3.22) and org-lookup (10.1.3.27) around 12:14 UTC. nginx upstream errors -> downstream 502s. logs:

```
2026-03-14T12:14:02Z ERROR auth-service: upstream timeout after 30s id=abc123 req=/v1/org/lookup 504
2026-03-14T12:14:03Z ERROR org-lookup: database connection timeout pool exhausted
```

maria (support): multiple customers report generation requests failing with 500s, some on Dedicated. ticket #5342 escalating.

ryan (infra): noticed a config push to auth-service 09:30 (fix for header parsing) — rolling back to previous image might help. also CPU on auth pods spiked 3x.

sam: first mitigation — enable org-lookup local cache / fallback for 60m and switch auth circuit breaker to relaxed mode. applying now.

sam: (runs) kubectl -n controlplane set env deployment/auth-service CIRCUIT_BREAKER=relaxed && kubectl -n controlplane set env deployment/org-lookup ENABLE_LOCAL_CACHE=true

deploy-bot: Started rollout: deployment/auth-service @sha:de4f... -> 3/3 updated (rolling) — 12:21 UTC

neha: after toggles, 5xx dropped to 1.8% over 3m but still above baseline. traces show reduced latency but some timeouts remain to billing service when verifying invoices — causing token validation to hang.

eve (product): any customers with live sessions impacted? need quick list for comms.

maria: support: we've identified 7 paying customers with errors >10% in last 10m. prepping a status update draft.

sam: next step: isolate billing dependency — add short-term bypass: if billing check times out >2s, return permissive token for existing orgs (non-privileged) and record event. patching config.

sam: patch snippet:
```
if billing.check(timeout=2000) == TIMEOUT:
    allow_token = token_cache.get(org_id)
```

ryan: increased auth-service replica count from 4 -> 8 and bumped resource limits. also restarted db proxy for org-lookup — restart completed 12:28.

neha: alert fingerprinter shows related deploy at 09:30 was high risk but passed tests. We'll file deployment rollback if we see more regressions.

sam: good signal: error rate now 0.6% over 5m, latency back to SLO. marking mitigation active. keeping circuit breaker and cache for 1h.

maria: fired status update to customers: "We are experiencing elevated 5xx errors caused by a control-plane dependency (auth/org-lookup). We've applied temporary mitigations and are monitoring. We'll provide updates every 30m." (added :thumbsup: reaction)

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigation_active -> monitoring.

neha: follow-up actions: 1) investigation into DB connection pool exhaustion 2) permanent circuit-breaker tuning 3) revert risky header parsing change and add integration tests 4) add synthetic checks for org-lookup latency 5) postmortem.

eve: assign owners: sam (mitigation/rollback), neha (infra root cause), ryan (capacity/config), maria (customer comms). target postmortem in 72h.

sam: handing to neha for on-call shift — i'm logging off in 15m. neha, please take over and escalate to SE if downstream billing not stable.

neha: taking handoff. current status summary:
- start_ts: 1760001234
- mitigation: local cache + relaxed circuit breaker + billing bypass
- impact: reduced from 6.2% -> 0.6% 5xx
- open tasks: check DB pool, revert header change, run load test
acknowledged.

ryan: saved heap dump and perf traces to s3://redwood-debug/1760001234/ — link: https://s3.redwood/1760001234/dumps

sam: thanks team. postmortem draft owner: neha. I'll create jira INC-176000.

maria: support note: customers notified, follow-ups queued.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: deployment/auth-service rolled back to @sha:ab12... 12:45 UTC

neha: closing handoff. if error spikes again, page oncall + start rollback to previous stable config. :white_check_mark:
